name: MNHLDG
recent: MN Holdings 近期获得价值 RM1.12 billion 的 400 MW 太阳能 EPCC 合约，并持续有凭单转换新股上市。同时，董事在闭市期内外有买卖股份的申报。
notable: 获得价值 RM1.12 billion 的 400 MW 太阳能项目 EPCC 合约。
凭单转换新股持续上市，最新一批 95,000 股将于 2026-11-24 上市。
执行董事 Datuk Dang Siong Diang 于 2026-11-17 在闭市期内以每股 RM2.93 增持 32,000 股。
risks: 独立非执行董事 Pankajkumar A/L Bipinchandra 于 2026-11-13 在闭市期内以每股 RM3.58 减持 200,000 股。
独立非执行主席 Dato' Sri Ir. Baharin Bin Din 于 2026-11-18 申报在闭市期内有意交易公司股份。
earnings: 最新季度（截至 2026-06-30）营收为 RM211.47 million，环比增长 5.7%，同比增长 17.9%；净利为 RM23.98 million，环比增长 12.1%，同比增长 98.8%；净利率为 11.3%，高于上一季度的 10.7%。

recent_en: MN Holdings recently secured a RM1.12 billion EPCC contract for 400 MW solar projects and has ongoing warrant conversion listings. Meanwhile, directors have reported share dealings both during and outside the closed period.
notable_en: Secured a RM1.12 billion EPCC contract for 400 MW solar projects.
Ongoing listing of new shares from warrant conversions, with the latest 95,000 shares to be listed on 24 Nov 2026.
Executive Director Datuk Dang Siong Diang acquired 32,000 shares at RM2.93 per share during the closed period on 17 Nov 2026.
risks_en: Independent Non-Executive Director Pankajkumar A/L Bipinchandra disposed of 200,000 shares at RM3.58 per share during the closed period on 13 Nov 2026.
Independent Non-Executive Chairman Dato' Sri Ir. Baharin Bin Din announced on 18 Nov 2026 his intention to deal in the company's shares during the closed period.
earnings_en: For the latest quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM211.47 million, up 5.7% QoQ and 17.9% YoY; net income was RM23.98 million, up 12.1% QoQ and 98.8% YoY; net margin was 11.3%, higher than 10.7% in the previous quarter.
